audit.whatIsWrong: diff says FAV and the win rate is 59.58% over 480 games — the highest in this slice — yet diffRating reads 8.5/10, breakdown.difficulty says 'Overall difficulty: 8.5/10', report[14] calls it a 'Hard matchup' and tone is the red band. The page simultaneously claims the lane is favoured and that it is one of the hardest Olaf plays.
audit.why: A 59.58% matchup with an Olaf-owned level chart is not an 8.5/10 difficulty. The rating appears to have been copied from carryRating.
audit.corrected: diffRating to 4/10, tone to the favoured band, and the two prose strings that quote the number updated to match. carryRating left at 8.5/10 — Quinn genuinely does take over late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Quinn five of seven rows (Quinn, Quinn, Quinn, Skill, Quinn, Skill, Quinn) while every why underneath says the opposite: whys[0] 'your Q slow into autos wins first contact', whys[1] 'you land a guaranteed true-damage burst', whys[2] 'she has no second escape', whys[3] 'out-sustain her Harrier chip', whys[4] the kill window, whys[5] 'your most oppressive point'. Only whys[6] gives Quinn the stage. Ratings of 2/10 sit on rows the prose describes as Olaf dominance.
audit.why: This is the widest chart-versus-prose disagreement in the slice and it inverts the whole matchup for the reader. The packet chart is Olaf for rows 0-5 and Quinn at 2+ items, which is exactly what the whys describe.
audit.corrected: Chart re-proposed as one atomic group across both layers: Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Quinn, with all seven ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The blind is attached to the wrong ability throughout. The page labels Vault as 'Vault (Dash/Blind)' and the content layer says 'her E vault knockback and blind' and 'Ragnarok cleanses her E vault blind/knockback'. Vault (E, 12/11/10/9/8s, 675 range) dashes to the target, damages, slows, briefly interrupts, then leaps her back out to her max attack range — no blind and no knockback on you. The vision-denial is Blinding Assault (Q, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, 1025 range). 'Ragnarok cleanses' is also wrong: Riot's text is immunity to disables held for as long as he keeps attacking.
audit.why: It makes the player watch the wrong bar. Vault is the escape you punish; Blinding Assault is the thing you eat and keep swinging through. Merging them into one 'Dash/Blind' means neither cooldown gets tracked properly, and it also hides the real shape of the trade — Vault removes her from your slow, it does not push you away.
audit.corrected: Blind re-attributed to Blinding Assault with its 11s; Vault given its 12s, its 675 range and the correct behaviour (she leaps away, which is why you commit immediately after she spends it). Ragnarok restated as immunity while attacking. Undertow's flat 9s and pickup reset used as the anti-kite tool.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Vault' repeated eight times with no duration.
audit.why: Vault at 12s rank 1 is the only escape she has; the whole plan is to commit inside that window.
audit.corrected: 12s and Blinding Assault's 11s written into the cooldown breakdown, the interactions line, the do's entry and the all-in window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Quinn referred to as 'he/his' in several full-layer strings, and report[2] reads 'His early — survive to your spikes', which is also factually backwards now.
audit.why: Quinn is female, and the early game belongs to Olaf.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cannot verify whether Ragnarok's disable immunity clears or prevents Blinding Assault's vision denial.
audit.why: Nearsight/blind classification is not in Riot's ability text and needsResearch is empty by design.
audit.corrected: Removed the 'cleanses the blind' claim; the advice is now to eat it and keep attacking, which is true regardless. See unverified.

edits.before: Quinn wants to poke you from range with Harrier procs and never let you walk up, but her cooldowns are the opening — lead with Q to slow her, then close and auto while your passive attack speed ramps. Don't blow E into thin air the second you reach her; she'll E-vault the knockback and blind off and reset the trade. Bait the vault, eat the blind on your autos, then re-Q off the ground to re-stick her and follow up. You out-damage her short trades all the way through level 3 as long as the axe slow lands.
edits.after: Quinn wants to poke you from range with Harrier procs and never let you walk up, but her cooldowns are the opening — lead with Undertow to slow her, then close and auto while your passive attack speed ramps. Don't blow Reckless Swing into thin air the second you reach her; Vault leaps her back out and resets the trade. Bait Vault, eat Blinding Assault on your autos, then pick the axe up to re-stick her and follow up. You out-damage her short trades through level 3 as long as the slow lands.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you snowball every short trade — your Q cooldown drops, you can chain axe pickups to perma-slow her, and W omnivamp heals the Harrier poke right back. Level 6 is the kill window: Ragnarok strips her E knockback/blind and the slow off you, so ult, Q to glue her, and E for the true-damage chunk she can't vault away from. Her only out is a flash or a missed Q — punish her the instant her vault is on cooldown.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you snowball every short trade — axe pickups reset Undertow off its flat 9s so she is never unslowed, and Vicious Strikes heals the Harrier poke right back. Level 6 is the kill window: press Ragnarok for the immunity, glue her with Undertow, and Reckless Swing for true damage she cannot vault away from. Her only out is Flash or a missed axe — punish her the instant Vault is on its 12s.

edits.before: Save Ragnarok to cleanse her E vault blind/knockback, then E her for guaranteed true damage
edits.after: Press Ragnarok the moment she spends Vault, then Reckless Swing her for true damage

edits.before: Hold E vault to knock you back, blind your autos, and reset every time you commit
edits.after: Hold Vault to leap out of your slow and reset the fight every time you commit

notes: Two structural problems. (1) The level chart gave Quinn five of seven rows on a 59.58% matchup while every why beneath the rows described Olaf winning them — the widest chart-versus-prose contradiction I found in this slice. Flipped rows 0-5 to Olaf in matched pairs with all ratings moved. (2) The blind was attached to Vault throughout ('Vault (Dash/Blind)'). Blinding Assault (Q, 11s, 1025 range) is the blind; Vault (E, 12s, 675) dashes in, interrupts and leaps her back out — it does not knock you back. Both fixed. I also changed diffRating from 8.5/10 to 4/10 and the tone colour: diff already read FAV and the win rate is the highest in the slice, but three strings called it a hard 8.5/10 matchup, which looks like carryRating copied into the wrong field — flagging it in questionsForUser in case 8.5 was deliberate. KIT FLAG MISFIRE: olaf.json tags Undertow with grounding, which would deny Vault's dash if true, but Riot's Undertow text is damage plus Armor and Move Speed reduction only — no grounding claim written.
